description:
21/114 query failures on ClickHouse in TPC-DI benchmark across 7 unique queries:
- AQ6: SUM(SUM(x)) OVER () nested window aggregate unsupported in ClickHouse
- AQ7, AQ8, AQ10: JULIANDAY() SQLite function not portable
- EQ7: FROM (VALUES (0)) not supported in ClickHouse FROM clause
- EQ3: Double-nested COUNT scalar subquery (always returns 1, not actual count)

Fixes applied:
- AQ6: Full query override with CROSS JOIN pre-computed grand total
- AQ7/AQ8/AQ10: JULIANDAY(x)-JULIANDAY(y) → dateDiff('day', y, x), DATE('now') → today()
- EQ7: FROM VALUES (N) AS alias → FROM (SELECT N) AS alias (post-SQLGlot regex)
- EQ3: Flatten double-nested COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) ...) (pre-SQLGlot regex)

Key insight: JULIANDAY replacements applied AFTER SQLGlot translation because SQLGlot
reorders dateDiff() argument order when parsing from netezza dialect.

preserves.behavior: Base query_analytics.py queries unchanged - other platforms use standard SQL JULIANDAY/NULLIF/FILTER syntax
Override queries return identical column names, types, and row semantics

verifications.description: ClickHouse TPC-DI overrides load and use native syntax

work_units.summary: Create ClickHouse overrides for AQ7, AQ8, AQ10 - replace JULIANDAY/DATE('now') with dateDiff/today()
Create ClickHouse override for AQ5 - rewrite NULLIF inside aggregates to if() expressions
Create ClickHouse override for AQ6 - replace SUM(SUM()) OVER () with CROSS JOIN total
Investigate and create ClickHouse overrides for EQ3, EQ7 - VALUES and double-nested COUNT
Verify all overrides load and pass syntax validation
